description: Annotated architecture map of the workspace — the first call to make in an unfamiliar repo. Directory tree with per-directory file/symbol counts, dominant language, role, size and import fan-in/fan-out (so layering is visible), plus entry points, the highest-fan-in symbols, and the third-party dependency inventory. One budgeted call instead of a grep sweep. Use path_prefix and depth to zoom into a subtree, and sections to ask for just one part. Ranking is structural and heuristic — distinct-file fan-in over resolved imports and call/type edges; reflection, DI and string-keyed dispatch are invisible to it, and stdlib/builtin classification is a partial list so unlisted modules fall back to "external".

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

depth.description: directory levels to roll up to; auto-reduced when the tree exceeds max_tokens

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

path_prefix.description: root-relative directory to map; omit for the whole workspace

name: repo_map
title: Repository map
